en: Tinted divided-view postcard showing two steep old-town stairways labeled 'Fingerlingstiege' (left) and 'Sagstiege' (right). Narrow houses with green shutters line the steps; an arched passage and a tall clock/bell tower rise in the right image. Caption in German reads 'Gruss aus Hermannstadt'. The back is a Hungarian-format postcard ('LEVELEZŐ-LAP') with a green 5 FILLER stamp and handwritten German address/message.
